# Konthora

> Konthora is a browser-based AI audio studio. It converts text into natural
> speech with 41 neural voices across 6 languages, and converts audio and video
> into transcripts with sentence, paragraph, or word-level timestamps.
> Everything runs through a FastAPI backend that models are served from locally.

## Tools

- [Text to Speech](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech): Convert up to 2,000 characters of text to MP3 or WAV. Adjustable speed (0.75x–1.25x), configurable sentence and paragraph pauses, optional text normalization. 41 voices, 6 languages (English, Hindi, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese).
- [Audio to Text](https://konthora.dev.bd/audio-to-text): Upload audio or video up to 100 MB / 10 minutes. Choose sentence, paragraph, or word-level timestamps. Export as TXT, SRT, VTT, or JSON.
- [MP3 to Text](https://konthora.dev.bd/mp3-to-text): MP3-specific transcription entry point.
- [Video to Text](https://konthora.dev.bd/video-to-text): Transcribe MP4, WebM, and MOV files.
- [Text to MP3](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-mp3): MP3 export entry point for narration.

## Voice catalogue

- [All AI Voices](https://konthora.dev.bd/voices): Full directory of every voice with accent, gender, language, and supported speed range.
- [American English Voices](https://konthora.dev.bd/voices/american-english-voices)
- [British English Voices](https://konthora.dev.bd/voices/british-english-voices)

Each individual voice has a page at `/voices/{slug}` with specifications and supported speeds.

## Transcription use cases

Task-specific guides. Each covers the workflow, the export format that suits
the use case, and how to handle media longer than the 10-minute limit.

- [Transcribe a podcast](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-podcast): Episode
  transcripts for show notes, accessibility and content repurposing. Covers
  splitting long episodes and two-host audio.
- [Transcribe an interview](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-interview):
  Pulling verifiable quotes. Covers two speakers on one track, accuracy limits,
  and recording consent.
- [Transcribe a meeting](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-meeting): Extracting
  decisions and action items. Covers multi-speaker calls and writing notes people
  actually read.
- [Transcribe a lecture](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-lecture): Accessible
  notes and captions. Covers splitting a long class recording and correcting
  technical vocabulary.
- [Transcribe video into subtitles](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-video):
  Subtitle timing standards, word-level timestamps for caption sync, and why
  burned-in captions are not transcribed.
- [Transcribe a voice memo](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-voice-memo):
  Getting an iPhone or Android memo off the device and turning a rough recording
  into usable notes.
- [Transcribe a webinar](https://konthora.dev.bd/transcribe-webinar): Splitting a
  presentation from its Q&A, and writing a follow-up registrants will read.

## Text-to-speech use cases

- [Text to speech for podcasts](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-podcasts):
  Narration for podcast segments and show intros.
- [Text to speech for YouTube videos](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-youtube-videos):
  Voiceover for explainer and tutorial videos.
- [Text to speech for presentations](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-presentations):
  Narration for slide decks and product walkthroughs.
- [Text to speech for e-learning](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-elearning):
  Narration for course modules and lessons.
- [Text to speech for social media](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-social-media):
  Short-form narration for posts and ads.
- [Text to speech for audiobooks](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech-for-audiobooks):
  Long-form narration, and the 2,000-character per-job limit when reading a
  chapter in parts.

- [Portuguese voices](https://konthora.dev.bd/text-to-speech/portuguese)

## Facts

- Pricing: free, no account required.
- Text limit: 2,000 characters per synthesis job.
- Upload limit: 100 MB and 10 minutes per transcription job.
- Accepted upload formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, MP4, WebM, MOV.
- Output formats: MP3, WAV (speech); TXT, SRT, VTT, JSON (transcripts).
- Transcription language support: English.
- Privacy: scripts are processed in memory and wiped after synthesis. Uploaded
  media and transcripts are deleted automatically after 60 minutes.
